 Senior Design Engineer Piping - - Vicoma Rotterdam - €3,598 - €4,798 per month 
 What are we looking for? 
Are you a decisive, customer-focused and knowledgeable professional with a passion for technology and innovation? At Vicoma, we are always open to new talent who want to contribute to a future-proof industry. Do you want to work on complex industrial challenges? 
At Vicoma, you get this opportunity within an organization where craftsmanship, flexibility, and a warm, collegial culture are central. You work alongside colleagues who know the profession inside and out; many have been with the company for years, meaning there is a wealth of knowledge and experience you benefit from every day. At Vicoma, professionals are given the space to take responsibility and work together on solutions that truly make an impact. What can you expect? Your role 
As a Senior Design Engineer Piping , you are responsible for designing, developing, and coordinating piping installations within industrial projects. You work on projects ranging from basic design to detail engineering and are technically involved from the initial site survey through to final delivery. 
You translate client requirements, P&IDs, and site information into technically robust and practically feasible designs. In doing so, you work largely independently, maintain direct contact with clients, and provide guidance to designers within projects when needed.
